title: Esrbespoke footer
description: A full-window paper footer on the 12-column grid: the name, a four-line company note at column 4 and the stacked links plus an underlined email field at column 9 along the top; a huge plain wordmark in the middle left; contact and address groups at column 9 below; a handle and a privacy link along the bottom. On desktop the page lifts off it (it waits underneath) and its small lines type themselves on as it arrives.
notes: reveal: the footer sticks to the bottom (desktop) so the page above lifts off it; give the content before it a background and a higher z-index (relative z-10)
the wordmark is plain text in the label face, sized to the window width; keep it short (about 7 letters)
the letters typing on need JavaScript (hydrate: visible); without it the text is simply shown
